details:
This update for agama fixes the following issues:

Changes in agama:

- Added support for the "inst.listen_on" boot parameter

  - The "inst.remote=0" option disables remote access
    (needed for CC compliant installation jsc#PED-16702)
  - It is possible to specify IP address (both IPv4 and IPv6)
    or network interface, accepts comma separated list
  - agama-web-server --address2 option removed, --address can now be repeated (jsc#AGM-153)

Update runtime dependencies to:

  - tracing-subscriber 0.3.20, CVE-2025-58160 (bsc#1249014)
  - bytes 1.12.1, CVE-2026-25541 (bsc#1274203)
  - serde_with 3.21.0, GHSA-7gcf-g7xr-8hxj (bsc#1271854)

- Clear the IP configuration (dns-search, addresses, gateway, ...)
  for disabled IP protocols, including values kept from the
  existing connection, to avoid errors in NetworkManager
  (bsc#1271644).

- Handle VLAN flags properly, using the kernel default value
  of VLAN_FLAG_REORDER_HDR when not specified
  (bsc#1271079).

- Rename the network device match settings attribute to "match"
  (bsc#1271235).
